Name: Delilah
Summary: Delilah was the woman Samson loved in the Valley of Sorek, whom the Philistine rulers paid to discover the secret of his strength. Her betrayal cost Samson his eyes and his freedom.
KeyStory: Four times Samson misled her, and four times she pressed him until he revealed that his strength lay in his Nazirite hair. While he slept, she had it cut, and the Philistines seized him.
LifeLesson: Delilah is a sober warning about love that is bought and trust given away piece by piece. Guard what God has set apart in you — and notice when affection keeps asking you to surrender it.
